Privacy Policy

Kids Sudoku Adventure — TinyGalaxy Games

Last updated: January 1, 2026 · Applies to: Kids Sudoku Adventure (iOS & Android)

We do NOT collect, store, or share any personal information from children. Kids Sudoku Adventure is 100% ad-free with no third-party tracking of any kind.

1. Our Commitment

TinyGalaxy Games ("we," "us," "our") built Kids Sudoku Adventure (the "App") for children and their families. We designed this App from the ground up to comply with the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) and the GDPR's provisions for children ("GDPR-K"). This policy explains, in plain language, exactly what we do — and more importantly, what we do not do — with any information related to your child.

2. Information We Do Not Collect

The App does not collect, store, transmit, or share any personally identifiable information (PII) from children, including but not limited to:

  • Name, email address, or physical address
  • Photos, videos, or voice recordings
  • Precise or approximate geolocation data
  • Device advertising identifiers (IDFA / GAID)
  • Contacts, social media profiles, or account credentials

The App requires no account creation, no sign-in, and no email address to play. Gameplay progress is stored locally on your child's device only.

3. No Advertising, No Tracking

Kids Sudoku Adventure contains:

  • Zero advertisements — no banner ads, no video ads, no rewarded ads, no third-party ad networks embedded in the App.
  • Zero third-party trackers — no analytics SDKs that fingerprint or profile individual children, no cross-app or cross-site tracking, no data brokers.
  • Zero behavioral advertising — we never build advertising profiles of children, and we never sell or rent data because none is collected.

4. Offline-First Design

The App is designed to be fully playable offline. Because most gameplay never requires a network connection, there is no continuous data transmission to our servers during play. Any optional network activity (such as checking for app updates) does not include personal information.

5. In-App Purchases

If the App offers optional purchases (such as a one-time premium unlock), all payment processing is handled entirely by Apple's App Store or Google Play. TinyGalaxy Games never receives, stores, or has access to payment card details. We do not use dark patterns, countdown pressure, or manipulative prompts designed to encourage purchases by children.

6. Parental Rights & Controls

Because we do not collect personal information, there is no child data profile to access, correct, or delete. If you have any concerns about your child's use of the App, or believe information was inadvertently collected, contact us and we will investigate and respond within 30 days.

7. Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA)

We comply with COPPA by design: the App does not request, collect, or maintain personal information from children under 13 without verifiable parental consent — and since we collect no personal information at all, no such consent is ever required. We do not condition participation in any game activity on the disclosure of more information than is reasonably necessary (in our case, none).

8. GDPR for Kids (GDPR-K)

For users in the European Economic Area, we apply the GDPR's heightened protections for children's data. As no personal data is processed, there is no lawful-basis assessment required, no data subject profile is created, and no international data transfer of children's personal data occurs.

9. Third-Party Services

The App does not embed third-party advertising SDKs, social media plugins, or behavioral analytics tools. Any infrastructure services we use (such as app store distribution) operate under their own privacy terms and do not receive personal information from the App on our behalf.

10. Data Security

Because gameplay data stays on-device and no personal information is transmitted or stored on our servers, there is no central database of children's data that could be exposed in a breach. We continue to follow industry-standard security practices for any infrastructure we operate.

11. Changes to This Policy

If we ever change this policy, we will update the "Last updated" date above and, for material changes, provide notice within the App. Any change will continue to honor our core promise: no personal data collection from children, no ads, no tracking.

12. Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or your child's use of Kids Sudoku Adventure, please reach out:
